resolution.note: ship runs scripts/fast-check.ts scoped checks before push; ship test: failing scoped check exits 65, no push call

title: Ship runs the checks of touched paths before it pushes
body:
Source: operator 2026-11-16: "agenci nie znają reguł z repozytorium" — tonight most PRs needed 2-4 CI rounds on rules the repo already enforces (biome on JSON, task-quality, spec/receivers.json, shard weights, standards-proposals test, Proof `cmd: verdict`, weak-tests line).
Outcome: `krn pr ship` runs the lint and test checks whose scope matches the changed paths before the push and exits 65 without pushing when one fails.
Proof: a ship test with a failing scoped check records no push call and exit 65.
Files: src/ci/ship.ts, test/ci/ship.test.ts
